title: What, Who, and When: Structured Harm Assessment for Mental Health Safety via Short Reasoning
description:
arXiv:2611.33263v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The growing use of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support raises important safety concerns. Existing guard models primarily identify categories of harmful content, often overlooking the context needed to determine an appropriate response.
